lines.before: 12. **Tests never yield to implementation.** When a test fails, scrutinize the implementation FIRST - dump what the code actually produces, compare to spec, then decide. NEVER weaken an assertion, relax a regex, accept "close enough", catch exceptions silently, or `.skip()` a test to make it pass. Moving a test's LOOKUP location is allowed only after verifying the implementation's output at the new location. **Test value:** every test guards a real use or a real failure, the way a person, caller or agent uses the code - no fluff to raise counts.
lines.after: 12. **Tests never yield to implementation.** When a test fails, scrutinize the implementation FIRST and leave the test as is - dump what the code actually produces, compare to spec, then decide. Moving a test's LOOKUP location is allowed only after verifying the implementation's output at the new location. **Test value:** every test guards a real use or a real failure, the way a person, caller or agent uses the code - no fluff to raise counts.

lines.before: 13. **Pre-PR Deep Sweep before any substantive PR.** No feature / sub-project PR opens or merges to `main` without a deep multi-agent sweep - an adversarial vulnerability swarm + the 6 Milestone-Sweep dimensions (incl. version-goal alignment) - under an approved Swarm Contract, with its report recorded. Scale to stakes by tier (rule:sweep-tiers): a feature gets the deep sweep, a fix the fix tier, a chore / docs / one-line PR the triage tier. Satisfied ONLY by the agents actually running this session + the report existing - NEVER by a self-review, a recalled prior sweep, or "it looks fine".
